title: The Excellence Award "Professor Zoe Dimitriadis Prize" to Konstantina Biza
excerpt: The University of Crete announces the awarding of the "Professor Zoe Dimitriadis Prize for Excellence" for the academic year 2022–2023, granted to postgraduate member of our laboratory Konstantina Biza.

title: Prof. Tsamardinos awarded the European Research Council Proof of Concept grant 2021
excerpt: The European Research Council Proof of Concept was awarded to Professor Tsamardinos in 2021, recognizing outstanding work in causal machine learning.

title: Open positions available — Calls for Expression of Interest
excerpt: Several contractual positions are open at the MensXMachina research group. Our group is highly multi-disciplinary focusing on data analysis and machine learning with an emphasis on biomedical data.
